commits.headline: fix(l10): correct class 1199 (Screamer) behavior doc comments
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
The doc comment incorrectly stated that class 1199 dies upon diving at
its target. It actually retreats to its spawn point and only enters
death state 13 when health is depleted by lethal damage.
